script.title: Inference Radar — 2026-07-05
script.intro: VLLM and SGLang see multiple PRs for model support and performance.

slides.heading: vLLM
bullets: Voxtral Realtime — fixes token feedback task timeout (#44461)
Mamba/Mamba2 — fixes loading checkpoint without architectures field (#46037)
Sequence Parallelism — 1.9% end-to-end throughput improvement (#47070)
slides.narration: Three landings on vLLM. Voxtral Realtime fixes a bug where the token feedback task would timeout. Mamba and Mamba2 checkpoints can now be loaded without an architectures field. Sequence Parallelism adds support without needing data parallelism, resulting in a 1.9% end-to-end throughput improvement.

slides.heading: SGLang
bullets: Metal RMSNorm kernel — at parity or better than mx.fast.rms_norm (#30163)
Fast Recovery Framework — reduces engine restart time to < 10 seconds (#27139)
slides.narration: Two key updates in SGLang. A custom Metal RMSNorm kernel is now available, offering performance at or better than the existing mx.fast.rms_norm implementation. Additionally, the Fast Recovery Framework significantly reduces engine restart time to under 10 seconds.

slides.heading: Megatron
bullets: MoE: Fix memory leak in full recompute mode (#5197)
FSDP: Fix Torch FSDP2 crash (#4953)
slides.narration: Megatron sees two important fixes. One addresses a memory leak issue in MoE architecture with full recomputation, and the other resolves a crash in Torch FSDP2.

slides.heading: TRT-LLM
bullets: Mamba SSD HAS_INITSTATES=True kernels warmup — 3.36% total token throughput improvement (#15876)
Qwen-Image-Layered FP8 support — includes SageAttention and Cache-DiT integration (#15096)
slides.narration: TRT-LLM introduces performance enhancements. Pre-JITing certain kernels during warmup improves total token throughput by 3.36%. Additionally, Qwen-Image-Layered FP8 support has been added, featuring SageAttention and Cache-DiT integration.
